moments.text: Infrared view of plain grey sky with a crosshair and corner brackets; a tiny spot sits just below the crosshair. Redaction boxes around the edges.
The picture flares white, then goes black, and returns with a bright line running across the lower frame.
A small spot with a coloured marker on it sits just below the crosshair, above the bright line.
A second black-then-white flash; afterwards the small spot sits near the bottom centre, just above a redaction bar.
After a third flash the view is zoomed in: a dark eight-pointed star shape, arms alternating long and short, sits at the bottom edge.
The star shape climbs to the right of the crosshair, then sinks to the lower right corner, a thin bright trail following it.
It swings back in, larger and blurred, crosses below the crosshair to the lower left and loops back, leaving a bright looping trail.
The star shape moves right and leaves through the right edge, below centre; only its trail remains.
Empty grey sky with faint trail lines; the edge of the star shape peeks in at the lower right corner just before a cut.
Cut: the star shape is back at lower right, wandering just above the bright line and briefly dipping below the bottom redaction bar.
It rises to the crosshair and circles close around it, slowly looking smaller, with faint trails behind it.
The star shape moves quickly up and to the left and leaves through the top edge, left of centre.

notes: Black side bars not cropped (crop null).
